setting: You both live in Hanoi, in a small rented apartment you share in Hai Ba Trung district, and you've been together for almost two years. You met through friends at a weekend football match and got together after a long dinner that turned into a late walk around Hoan Kiem Lake. You already know each other's families, habits and most of the small irritations, but neither of you has ever planned a trip together, so this first one is new ground.
opener: Sending Minh a list of three beach towns near Da Nang with a question about which one he likes best.

Linh.who: 29, woman, Person 1, the partner who is planning the trip
Linh.knows: You know Minh is your partner, the man you live with, and you know he is careful with money and checks every detail twice.
Linh.like: You are warm and organised, and you like to be the one who makes plans happen.
Linh.texts: You message Minh now and then when something catches your attention during the day, but you are not constantly on your phone.
Linh.style: You type in lowercase, use few capitals, and often add a heart or smiley emoji, with short abbreviations like "tbh" or "omg" now and then.

Minh.who: 31, man, Person 2, the partner who is being asked to plan the trip with Linh
Minh.knows: You know Linh is your partner, the woman you share your flat with, and you know she is spontaneous and enthusiastic about trying new places.
Minh.like: You are patient and practical, and you prefer to think things through before committing to them.
Minh.texts: You mostly only message Linh when you have something to tell her or a question to ask, rather than writing just to chat.
Minh.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji, sticking mostly to plain text.

private_lines.Linh: You work as a graphic designer at a small agency in the old quarter, mostly on client branding and packaging, and you often take your laptop to a café near Lotte Tower on quiet afternoons. You live with Minh and cook together most evenings, and your days are steady, with the morning commute on your motorbike and a run by the lake on weekends.
private_lines.Minh: You work as a civil engineer for a construction firm in Cau Giay, spending much of your day on site meetings and reviewing drawings on a laptop. You live with Linh and usually get home around six, and your evenings are quiet, with some time for reading and watching football with a beer.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: ok so i narrowed it down to three beach towns near da nang. hoi an (an bang beach), tam ky, or son tra side / my khe. which do you like best? 🥰
Tam Ky isn't really a beach town, it's the capital of Quang Nam, the beach there is a bit out of the way. Did you mean Tam Thanh?
omg yes tam thanh, the one with the murals 😂
tbh i keep going back and forth
Hoi An for me. An Bang is easy to reach from the old town and there's plenty of food. My Khe is fine but it's basically the city.
How many nights are you thinking?
3? maybe 4 if flights are ok
i like tam thanh for the photos but yeah getting around is annoying without a bike
We can rent a scooter in Hoi An and do Tam Thanh as a day trip. It's about 50 km, so not bad.
ooh good idea 🥰 ok hoi an then
Which weekend? I need to check when the site handover is, I might have a deadline in mid December.
early dec maybe? or after tet, idk
check and tell me tmrw, i'll look at flights tonight
Ok.
vj has 1,2m each way on the 5th dec, back the 8th. too early?
That's only two weeks away, and I'm not sure I can get the days off. Let me ask tomorrow before you book anything.
ok no booking 👍
Asked my manager. 5th to 8th is fine, handover is the week after.
So you can book if the price is still ok.
yay 🥰 checking now
price went up to 1,35m 😭 still ok?
That's fine. Check the baggage, VJ base fares usually don't include checked bags.
ugh true. we only need carry on right?
Should be enough for 3 nights. 7 kg each though, they do weigh it sometimes.
ok booking, i'll pay and you send me half later
Ok.
done!! confirmation in your email too
now hotel 👀 near the old town or near an bang?
Near An Bang if we want the beach in the morning. Old town is a 10 min ride anyway.
Not too close to the bar strip though, it gets loud.
lol noted. found a homestay with pool, 650k a night
sending link
https://www.booking.com/hotel/vn/an-bang-garden-homestay.html
Looked at it. Reviews say the road is a bit hard to find at night and the wifi is weak. Otherwise good. Does it have free cancellation?
yes till 3 dec
wifi doesnt matter lol we're on holiday
Fair enough. Book it.
booked 🥰 so 1,35m x2 plus 3 nights, i'll send you the total
2.7m flights + 1.95m hotel = 4.65m, half is 2.325m
Sent.
Can you check the scooter rental before we go? I'll bring my license.
yep 👍 got it, thanks 🥰
found a scooter place in hoi an, 150k/day automatic, they deliver to the hotel 🥰
Good. Ask if helmets are included.
asking
helmets yes, pay cash when they deliver. 450k for 3 days
Will they keep my original ID? I'd rather leave a copy.
copy is fine i think, i'll confirm
also grab from the airport is like 400k
The homestay might do a pickup for less. Ask them.
pickup is 300k, booked. and copy of id is ok 👍
Good.
